vocab.exampleEn: The underlying problem is not vocabulary, but a lack of practice using it.
vocab.exampleZh: 深层问题不是词汇量，而是缺少使用词汇的练习。
vocab.upgradeEn: Use underlying cause/problem/reason in reading and writing.
vocab.upgradeZh: 常用搭配：underlying cause / problem / reason。

cycle.summaryEn: Turn simple ideas into cleaner IELTS lines and link them smoothly.
cycle.summaryZh: 把简单意思改成更像雅思答案的表达，并把句子连起来。

frame.useEn: Use to show your opinion clearly.

meaningEn: This reading word helps Becky understand questions and paraphrases faster.
meaningZh: 这个阅读词可以帮助 Becky 更快看懂题目和改写。
promptEn: China drill: read the Chinese meaning, shadow the example twice, then make one Becky-style sentence with "underlying" using In my view, ...
promptZh: 中文母语者练法：先看中文意思，跟读例句两遍，再用 "underlying" 和 在我看来，... 写一句 Becky 自己的话。
sourceEn: This harder word is auto-picked for Becky and refreshes every day with a China-friendly output drill.
sourceZh: 这个高分词会每天自动为 Becky 刷新，并配中文母语者适用的输出练习。
